SUMMARY.md:
> MoviOdds serves exclusively bet365 odds for soccer, tennis, basketball, American football, ice hockey, baseball, rugby union and league, cricket and Australian rules (more sports being added): every market bet365 prices for a match, pre-match and in-play. Soccer is the default; pass sport=<key> (see the sport parameter), or sport=all, to /odds and /catalog for other sports. Load the board with GET /odds, then keep it current over the WebSocket at wss://moviodds.com/ws (send {"op":"subscribe"}, optionally with "fixtures" and "groups" lists; you receive a snapshot per match, then delta messages as prices change, and a remove message when a market closes or a match leaves the board). WebSockets are not describable in OpenAPI, so the stream is documented at https://moviodds.com/doc.
>
> The odds feed needs no key. Only POST /betbuilder/price needs an API key (X-API-Key).
>
> MoviOdds is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by bet365.
Event name, for example 'Bahrain Grand Prix', 'NFL 2026/27', 'AFL 2027', 'World Cup 2027'.
Every current quote for the match
One result per slip, in request order

Per sport, the most recent time a fixture for that sport was seen in a catalog sweep. A recent timestamp means the sport is being read (a quiet off-week); a stale or missing one suggests a broken sport.
The finished matches for the sport, newest first.

The last scoreline seen (aggregate home-away; a comma-separated set list for set sports; for cricket bet365's Australian wickets/runs per innings in batting order, for example 7/199,8/141). For table tennis, badminton and volleyball the deciding set is included even though bet365 delists the match before adding it to its completed-set field.

The outright events for the sport, each with its markets and current prices. A valid sport with no futures (a covered sport still warming, or a real sport the feature does not cover) returns an empty events list. When the whole feature is off: {"enabled": false}.
True right after a restart while the board loads.
bet365 class id (F1 10, golf 7, cycling 38, American football 12, baseball 16, ice hockey 17, basketball 18, rugby union 8, rugby league 19, Australian rules 36).
bet365 event id (the drilled body's EV FI).
